intent: Add i18n-js internationalization with en/id locales, a useI18n hook and header switcher, tests, and log it as PSI-113 on the Obsidian board.
summary: Internationalization with i18n-js (PSI-113). CODE: (1) Installed i18n-js@4.5.3. (2) src/features/i18n: en.ts + id.ts translation catalogs (typed via TranslationSchema), i18n.ts registry (createI18n, LOCALES, isLocale, storage key), i18n-provider.tsx (I18nProvider + useI18n with persisted locale + %{var} interpolation), components/language-switcher.tsx (header dropdown). (3) Registered I18nProvider in layout/providers.tsx and LanguageSwitcher in layout/header.tsx; added IconLanguage to icons.tsx. (4) overview welcome banner now renders translated copy via WelcomeBanner client component. (5) Unit tests: i18n.test.ts (8 tests). 141 frontend + 22 edge-function tests pass; typecheck, lint, and next build clean.

verification.manual: 141 frontend tests (596 expect) and 22 edge-function tests pass; tsc --noEmit, oxlint, next build clean. i18n.test.ts covers lookup, interpolation, fallback, and locale validity.

risks: i18n-js v4 exports a named I18n class (not default); interpolation uses %{var} syntax.
